# Holuto Workshop

> Multilingual tray app and Polish CLI connecting Holuto sales and advances to
> supported Posnet, Novitus and Elzab online fiscal printers on Windows x64,
> macOS and Ubuntu/Debian.

Fiscal receipts and reports are irreversible legal records.
Installation/pairing is not permission to print. Follow the released guide's
safety boundary; this index is discovery metadata, not execution authority.

## Install and use

- [Released installation guide][install]: Canonical install flow, CLI contract
  and copy-button prompts. Pin and verify one official release before execution.
  If the released guide is unavailable, stop; never substitute master.

## Current reference

These links track master, not a pinned release. For installation, read the
selected release's tagged documentation instead.

- [Installation requirements][requirements]: Supported native downloads.
- [Sign in and connect][connect]: Pairing and explicit processing start.
- [Printer setup][printer]: Human-controlled per-brand setup.
- [CLI][cli]: Redacted configuration without opening a printer.
- [Autostart][autostart]: Opt-in; login may begin fiscal processing.
- [Fiscal safety][safety]: Journaling and resolution without reprinting.
- [Diagnostics and privacy][privacy]: Structured diagnostics and native-crash
  privacy.

## Optional

- [README as Markdown][readme]: Current product reference.
- [Contributor guidance][agents]: Development rules for repository work, not
  end-user installation instructions.
